package tun

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"net/netip"
	"os"
	"testing"

	"github.com/sagernet/sing/common/ranges"
)

type vecCase struct {
	Name    string
	Options Options
}

func p(s string) netip.Prefix { return netip.MustParsePrefix(s) }

func TestDumpVectors(t *testing.T) {
	cases := []vecCase{
		{"v4_auto", Options{Name: "tun0", AutoRoute: true, Inet4Address: []netip.Prefix{p("172.19.0.1/30")}}},
		{"dual_auto_strict", Options{Name: "tun0", AutoRoute: true, StrictRoute: true, Inet4Address: []netip.Prefix{p("172.19.0.1/30")}, Inet6Address: []netip.Prefix{p("fdfe:dcba:9876::1/126")}}},
		{"v4_strict", Options{Name: "tun0", AutoRoute: true, StrictRoute: true, Inet4Address: []netip.Prefix{p("172.19.0.1/30")}}},
		{"uid", Options{Name: "tun1", AutoRoute: true, Inet4Address: []netip.Prefix{p("172.19.0.1/30")}, Inet6Address: []netip.Prefix{p("fdfe:dcba:9876::1/126")}, IncludeUID: []ranges.Range[uint32]{ranges.New[uint32](1000, 1000), ranges.New[uint32](2000, 3000)}, ExcludeUID: []ranges.Range[uint32]{ranges.New[uint32](2500, 2500)}}},
		{"exclude_uid", Options{Name: "tun0", AutoRoute: true, Inet4Address: []netip.Prefix{p("172.19.0.1/30")}, ExcludeUID: []ranges.Range[uint32]{ranges.New[uint32](0, 0)}}},
		{"include_if", Options{Name: "tun0", AutoRoute: true, Inet4Address: []netip.Prefix{p("172.19.0.1/30")}, Inet6Address: []netip.Prefix{p("fdfe:dcba:9876::1/126")}, IncludeInterface: []string{"eth0", "wlan0"}}},
		{"exclude_if", Options{Name: "tun0", AutoRoute: true, Inet4Address: []netip.Prefix{p("172.19.0.1/30")}, ExcludeInterface: []string{"docker0"}}},
		{"route_exclude", Options{Name: "tun0", AutoRoute: true, Inet4Address: []netip.Prefix{p("172.19.0.1/30")}, Inet6Address: []netip.Prefix{p("fdfe:dcba:9876::1/126")}, Inet4RouteExcludeAddress: []netip.Prefix{p("192.168.0.0/16"), p("10.0.0.0/8")}, Inet6RouteExcludeAddress: []netip.Prefix{p("fc00::/7")}}},
		{"route_address", Options{Name: "tun0", AutoRoute: true, Inet4Address: []netip.Prefix{p("172.19.0.1/30")}, Inet4RouteAddress: []netip.Prefix{p("1.0.0.0/8"), p("8.8.0.0/16")}, Inet4RouteExcludeAddress: []netip.Prefix{p("8.8.8.8/32")}}},
		{"route_address_no_auto", Options{Name: "tun0", Inet4Address: []netip.Prefix{p("172.19.0.1/30")}, Inet4RouteAddress: []netip.Prefix{p("198.18.0.0/15")}}},
		{"v6_only", Options{Name: "tun0", AutoRoute: true, StrictRoute: true, Inet6Address: []netip.Prefix{p("fdfe:dcba:9876::1/126")}}},
	}
	for i := range cases {
		c := &cases[i]
		c.Options.IPRoute2TableIndex = DefaultIPRoute2TableIndex
		c.Options.IPRoute2RuleIndex = DefaultIPRoute2RuleIndex
		c.Options.IPRoute2AutoRedirectFallbackRuleIndex = DefaultIPRoute2AutoRedirectFallbackRuleIndex
	}
	out := map[string]any{}
	for _, c := range cases {
		nt := &NativeTun{options: c.Options}
		var rules []map[string]any
		for _, r := range nt.rules() {
			m := map[string]any{"family": r.Family, "priority": r.Priority, "table": r.Table, "goto": r.Goto, "invert": r.Invert, "type": r.Type, "iif": r.IifName, "oif": r.OifName, "suppress_prefixlen": r.SuppressPrefixlen, "mark": r.Mark, "mark_set": r.MarkSet, "mask": r.Mask}
			if r.Dst.IsValid() {
				m["dst"] = r.Dst.String()
			}
			if r.Src.IsValid() {
				m["src"] = r.Src.String()
			}
			if r.UIDRange != nil {
				m["uid"] = fmt.Sprintf("%d-%d", r.UIDRange.Start, r.UIDRange.End)
			}
			if r.Dport != nil {
				m["dport"] = fmt.Sprintf("%d-%d", r.Dport.Start, r.Dport.End)
			}
			rules = append(rules, m)
		}
		ranges, _ := c.Options.BuildAutoRouteRanges(false)
		var rs []string
		for _, r := range ranges {
			rs = append(rs, r.String())
		}
		out[c.Name] = map[string]any{"rules": rules, "routes": rs}
	}
	data, _ := json.MarshalIndent(out, "", " ")
	os.WriteFile(os.Getenv("VEC_OUT"), data, 0o644)
}
